rule.accept: Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin|none, OR Origin host===Host, OR no Origin
rule.reject: foreign Origin or cross-site Sec-Fetch-Site -> 403 JSON
rule.credential: when operatorAuthToken configured, mutating /api/role-model/* requires Authorization Bearer matching token
rule.cors: mutating /api/role-model/* responses no ACAO; GET unchanged *; OPTIONS mutating 204 no ACAO

clientImpact: runtime-config client now sends stored operator token; same-origin UI unaffected; foreign-origin writes now 403; reverse proxy must preserve Host/Origin
